verdict.rationale: First-party docs say scheduled tasks can start automatically when a supported Gmail, Slack, or GitHub event occurs. The documented examples are triaging new email, summarizing channel activity, and acting on pull request feedback without polling. Users can also review active, paused, and completed tasks and their recent runs. Missing for 10: documentation of rule conditions or filters beyond event type, event sources beyond Gmail/Slack/GitHub, and independent or hands-on corroboration that event triggers work as described.
